reviews.text:
This is easily one of the best oil cleansers on the market for a reason! The texture feels rich and cushiony on the skin, yet it’s completely lightweight and non-comedogenic. It dissolves waterproof makeup, SPF, and daily grime effortlessly without needing to rub hard. Once you add water, it emulsifies into a gorgeous milky texture that rinses off completely clean without leaving a greasy film behind. Plus, with regular use, it works wonders for gently melting away blackheads and keeping pores clear!
​✅ Pros:
​Effortlessly dissolves stubborn makeup, waterproof SPF, and excess sebum
​Emulsifies quickly and rinses off cleanly with zero greasy residue
​Helps melt blackheads and smooth skin texture over time
​Packed with nourishing plant oils that respect the skin barrier
​Never stings the eyes or leaves a blurry film
​❌ Cons:
​It has a subtle herbal/citrus botanical scent—absolutely lovely, but worth noting if you are 100% fragrance-free.
reviews.zh:
呢個係市面上最好嘅卸妝油之一，係有原因嘅！質地豐潤、軟綿綿，但係非常輕盈、無致痘。可以輕鬆溶解防水化妝品、防曬同日常污垢，唔需要用力擦。加水之後會乳化成漂亮嘅乳白色質地，沖洗之後都乾乾淨淨，冇油膩薄膜殘留。加埋定期使用，對溶解黑頭、保持毛孔暢通都有好效果！
✅ 優點：
輕鬆溶解頑固化妝、防水防曬同多餘油脂
快速乳化，沖洗乾淨，零油膩殘留
幫助溶解黑頭，長期使用令皮膚紋理更光滑
含豐富植物油，尊重皮膚屏障
唔會刺激眼睛，亦唔會留低模糊薄膜
❌ 缺點：
有少少草本／柑橘嘅植物香味——好好聞，但如果你係完全唔含香料都要留意。

reviews.text: I’ve tried so many cleansing oils that either sting my eyes or leave my skin feeling stripped, but this one has been a pleasant surprise. My skin is extremely reactive, but it removed sunscreen and makeup without causing redness or irritation. It emulsifies easily and rinses clean without leaving a greasy film. I’ve been using it daily and haven’t experienced any breakouts or congestion. My skin feels soft and comfortable after cleansing. Definitely a repurchase for me.
reviews.zh: 我試過好多卸妝油，有啲會刺痛眼睛，有啲會令皮膚乾澀，但呢款係一個驚喜。我皮膚非常易敏感，但佢可以卸除防曬同化妝，冇引起發紅或刺激。佢容易乳化，沖洗乾淨，冇留低油膜。我每日都用，冇出現爆痘或者阻塞。潔面後皮膚感覺軟滑舒服。絕對會再買。

reviews.text: it’s my first time trying product from this brand and i was just wondering why some of their product doesn’t go viral. this oil cleanser is very velvet on the skin, the texture is in between light and thick which is very nice for all skin type, it’s very velvet when apply to the skin. the mixture of different natural oils is very good in regeneration of the skin. i just found my new baby 👌🏽
reviews.zh: 呢個係我第一次試呢個品牌嘅產品，我好奇點解佢哋某啲產品都唔爆紅。呢款卸妝油摸落好幼滑，質地喺輕同厚之間，好啱所有膚質，塗喺皮膚上時好似絲絨咁幼滑。混合咗唔同嘅天然油，好有助皮膚再生。我啱啱搵到我嘅新寶貝 👌🏽

reviews.text:
This cleansing oil does an excellent job of removing makeup, SPF, and all the impurities that build up throughout the day. It rinses off easily, doesn’t leave an oily residue, and leaves my skin feeling clean, soft, and comfortable without any tightness.

I also want to mention that it hasn’t caused any new breakouts, even though my skin is acne-prone and usually reacts poorly to oil-based products. I’ve been using it every evening as the first step of my cleansing routine and have been very happy with the results.
reviews.zh:
呢款卸妝油好好咁去除化妝、防曬同一日累積嘅污垢。沖走好容易，唔會留低油膩感，令我皮膚感覺乾淨、軟滑、舒服，冇緊繃感。

我都想提一提，佢冇令我爆新痘，雖然我皮膚易生暗瘡，通常對油性產品反應唔好。我每晚都用，作為我潔面程序嘅第一步，對效果好滿意。

reviews.text:
I can not rave about how incredible this oil cleanser is. I have very dry skin and i had watched a review on Youtube about this oil cleanser. I don't regret it.
1 pump covers my whole face. 2 pumps for the days i wear a lot of makeup. Just remember to add water to emulsify the oil in the end and then rinse it off. I've been using it every night for the past 24 days, so I'm not saying this for nothing!
I'm for sure buying a second bottle asap.
reviews.zh:
我真係忍唔住要讚呢款卸妝油有幾好。我皮膚好乾，我喺 YouTube 睇過一個評測先買呢款。我唔後悔。
一泵可以覆蓋成張面，化好濃嘅妝嗰日用兩泵。記住最後要加水令油乳化，再沖走。我每晚都用，連續用咗 24 日，所以我唔係亂講嘅！
我一定會盡快再買多一樽。

reviews.text: ​After using this for a few weeks, I can see why it’s a bestseller. It melts away waterproof mascara and long-wear foundation without any aggressive scrubbing. My favorite part is how easily it emulsifies; it turns milky and rinses off clean without leaving that "filmy" feeling on my eyes. It hasn't clogged my pores or caused any breakouts. If you have sensitive skin but need a deep clean, this is the one!
reviews.zh: 用咗幾個星期之後，我明白點解佢係暢銷產品。佢可以溶解防水睫毛膏同長效粉底，唔使用力擦。我最鍾意嘅係佢乳化得好快，加水之後會變成奶白色，沖洗乾淨，眼周冇「油膜」嘅感覺。佢冇堵塞毛孔，亦冇引致爆痘。如果你皮膚敏感但需要深層清潔，呢款就係你要揀嘅！

reviews.text:
I've tried a dozen oil cleansers, but the Ma:nyo Pure Cleansing Oil is the first one that feels like it's actually doing the work without leaving a greasy feeling. It melts down my waterproof mascara.

The best part? It emulsifies into a light milk perfectly when you add water. My skin feels soft and clean, not stripped. If you have stubborn blackheads, definitely spend an extra minute massaging this into your nose area-it's a game changer!
reviews.zh:
我試過十幾款卸妝油，但 Ma:nyo Pure Cleansing Oil 係第一款真正做到嘢、又唔會留低油膩感嘅。佢可以溶掉我嘅防水睫毛膏。

最好嘅係？加水之後，佢會乳化成輕盈嘅奶狀。皮膚摸落軟滑、乾淨，唔會好似被剝奪咗水分。如果你有頑固黑頭，記得花多一分鐘將呢款按摩入鼻位，效果真係改變遊戲規則！

reviews.text: Indulging in the ma:nyo Pure Cleansing Oil has truly elevated my skincare routine to new heights. As a fervent believer in the importance of effective cleansing, this product has won my heart and secured its place as an essential step in my regimen. The oil effortlessly dissolves makeup, sunscreen, and impurities, leaving my skin feeling clean and nourished. What's truly remarkable is how this cleansing oil doesn't leave a greasy residue; instead, it emulsifies beautifully upon contact with water, ensuring a thorough and effortless rinse. The formulation is thoughtful and effective, providing a deep cleanse without stripping my skin of its natural moisture. After every use, my skin feels soft, refreshed, and prepared for the next steps in my routine.
reviews.zh: 用咗 ma:nyo Pure Cleansing Oil 之後，我嘅護膚程序真係提升咗好多。作為一個堅定嘅有效潔面信徒，呢款產品贏得咗我嘅心，成為我護膚程序入面不可或缺嘅一步。呢款卸妝油可以輕鬆溶解化妝、防曬同污垢，令皮膚感覺乾淨、有滋養。最令我驚喜嘅係，呢款卸妝油唔會留低油膩感，遇水之後會美妙咁乳化，確保徹底、輕鬆沖洗。配方好用心、好有效，深層清潔，但唔會剝奪皮膚嘅天然水分。每次用完，我嘅皮膚都感覺柔軟、清爽，為之後嘅護膚步驟做好準備。
